additional_info.subject: Case Update
additional_info.body:
RC visited the site yesterday i.e 29th Jan.
RC's finding:
1) Liquid cooled cable on outlet 2 was installed by customer
2) It was not installed correctly.
3) As soon as they enable outlet 2, liquid starts flowing through cable.
4) RC deactivated outlet 2 from PLC configuration.
5) RC will not consider this cable replacement under warranty.

additional_info.subject: Case Update
additional_info.body:
Charging cable was not changed from "no cable to 500A cable on outlet DC2 as it was deactivated by RC.
I have updated this PLC configuration.
After updating PLC configuration, we have new error flag.
As GSH is “0” this means Good Signal Lost/Wiring error/ LOGO Comm lost/ 24V to cable lost.
Error Code 4 is Cable Good Signal CAN Bus lost while CAN communication is OK.
